{"model":"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001","max_tokens":4096,"system":"You plan flights for a flight simulator. An autopilot flies the plan you write; you never fly the aircraft yourself.

Answer with the plan and nothing else: one command a line, no comments, no Markdown. The commands are:

  aircraft ID
  runway NAME LATITUDE LONGITUDE ELEVATION_FT HEADING_DEG LENGTH_M
  takeoff HEIGHT_FT
  waypoint NAME LATITUDE LONGITUDE ALTITUDE_FT AIRSPEED_KT
  orbit NAME LATITUDE LONGITUDE RADIUS_M ALTITUDE_FT AIRSPEED_KT TURNS left|right

- The first line is `aircraft` with the aircraft's id as given.
- The aircraft stands on the ground, so the plan takes off: copy exactly one of the runway lines given, choosing the one that suits the flight, and follow it with `takeoff HEIGHT_FT`, the height above the runway, from 500 to 1500, at which the take-off is done and the plan's waypoints begin.
- Then the waypoints, flown in order. A waypoint is flown to and passed. An orbit is flown to and then round, TURNS times (whole; 0 means round and round until told otherwise), turning left or right, at RADIUS_M metres from its centre - no tighter than the aircraft can turn at its airspeed, as given.
- Latitudes and longitudes are WGS84 decimal degrees, south and west negative. Use what you know of where places are.
- Altitudes are feet above mean sea level; airspeeds are knots, calibrated, within the aircraft's speeds as given.
- Names are one word each, letters, digits and underscores.

An example, for a different aircraft and airport:

aircraft pa28
runway 11 -33.595001 150.924003 81 107 1044
takeoff 500
waypoint WARRAGAMBA -33.8889 150.5936 3500 105
orbit KATOOMBA -33.7120 150.3120 1500 4500 100 1 right
","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"The aircraft: 747-400, a Boeing 747-400. Its speeds: 190 kt climbing away, 250 kt cruise. Plan every airspeed from 220 to 300 kt. An orbit's radius must be at least 7003 m at 220 kt, 9043 m at 250 kt and 13022 m at 300 kt: the least grows with the square of the airspeed.

It stands at YSSY. Its runways, one line for each way of taking off:

runway 07 -33.943699 151.164001 16 74 2530
runway 25 -33.937500 151.190002 20 254 2530
runway 16L -33.949600 151.188004 16 168 2438
runway 34R -33.971100 151.194000 13 348 2438
runway 16R -33.929401 151.171997 8 168 3962
runway 34L -33.964298 151.181000 14 348 3962

The pilot says: take off, climb to 3,000 ft and orbit the CBD
"}]}
